english.title: Driver use a London PHV fail to exhibit disc / plate - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which a London private hire vehicle licence related, when that vehicle was being used as a private hire vehicle on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD..), in London, failed to exhibit on the vehicle in the prescribed manner the

(A)_[disc]_
(B)_[plate]_

issued under section 10 of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(2), (4) and (7) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes: Section 10(6) provides that it is a defence in proceedings for an offence under section 10(4) for the driver to show that he exercised all due diligence to prevent the vehicle being used in contravention of section 10(2).
